verifications.claim: All Publix store locations and pharmacies will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Our stores will be closed on Easter Sunday" (R1); "all of its stores and pharmacies will be closed for the holiday" (R2); "We will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5" (R4); "all Publix stores are closed on Easter" (R5); "Publix: Closed" (R6); "Publix is never open on Easter Sunday" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm Publix stores and pharmacies closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.

verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state Publix closes for exactly these three holidays annually.
